title: Populate overview index on POST
description: After a successful POST (article written to IPFS and appended to group_log), extract the OVER fields (Subject, From, Date, Message-ID, References, :bytes, :lines) from the article and insert them into the overview SQLite index. The overview schema and extraction logic already exist in store/overview.rs. Why: OVER/XOVER is the primary command newsreader clients use to download thread lists; an empty index means clients see no articles.
